scope: Primary-source documentation review for voluntary external-agent federation
coverage: bounded; no claim of whole-network discovery

onion_scientific_service_finding.note: No verified operator, callable scientific-agent interface and genome R&D participation conditions were jointly established. This does not prove nonexistence.

solutions.name: MCP Registry
solutions.role: Candidate server discovery through an aggregator
solutions.license: Per-server and underlying-package licenses must be checked separately
solutions.boundary: Metadata and namespace authentication do not certify code safety or scientific quality

solutions.name: A2A
solutions.role: Known Agent Card discovery and scoped task delegation
solutions.license: Check chosen SDK release and provider contract separately
solutions.boundary: Protocol is not a global directory and does not grant participation rights

solutions.name: Agentverse and uAgents
solutions.role: Search agents by text and protocol digest
solutions.license: Code, hosted service and result terms separate; exact code license not rechecked here
solutions.boundary: Search hit or active status does not establish competence or opt-in

solutions.name: Olas Mech Marketplace
solutions.role: Procurement of one benchmarked tool service
solutions.access: Payment setup and provider selection; on-chain or off-chain requests
solutions.license: Client and provider rights separate; commit review required
solutions.boundary: Off-chain is not free; no confirmed barter agreement

solutions.name: Virtuals ACP
solutions.role: Job proposal, budget, delivery and independent acceptance pattern
solutions.access: SDK v2 and chain-specific account/payment setup
solutions.license: Check exact SDK and service terms before connection
solutions.boundary: Escrow completion does not establish scientific validity

solutions.name: Bittensor
solutions.organization: Independent subnet operators in Bittensor ecosystem
solutions.role: Compare a specific compute, inference or data subnet with a conventional API
solutions.access: Service-specific; chain rewards use TAO; SDK/CLI v11
solutions.license: Per-subnet models and service terms require separate checks
solutions.boundary: Network reward scores are not scientific replication

solutions.name: Biomni
solutions.role: Isolated computational biomedical worker on permitted benchmarks
solutions.access: Local environment and configured LLM provider
solutions.license: Repository Apache-2.0; tools, models and data separately licensed
solutions.boundary: Source availability does not attach a remote operator or validate clinical predictions

solutions.name: PaperQA2
solutions.role: Evidence extraction, literature review and contradiction checks
solutions.access: Configured LLM/embeddings; pin a CalVer release or commit
solutions.license: Repository Apache-2.0; source documents separately licensed
solutions.boundary: Generated citations and conclusions require checking

solutions.name: Tor onion services
solutions.role: Optional transport for a known consenting endpoint
solutions.license: Component licenses and endpoint terms checked separately
solutions.boundary: Privacy transport is neither a trust credential nor a scientific-agent directory

solutions.name: Ahmia
solutions.role: Bounded metadata discovery for subsequent identity checks
solutions.access: Public search interface; no exhaustive coverage established
solutions.license: About identifies open-source components; pin and inspect each component license before reuse
solutions.boundary: Indexed URL does not establish operator, license or competence

solutions.name: DarkOwl Search API
solutions.role: Project asset compromise and endpoint provenance monitoring
solutions.license: Contract controls export, retention and AI use
solutions.boundary: CTI data is not a source of rights to stolen genomic data and is not an agent society

solutions.name: EGA data access
solutions.organization: European Genome-phenome Archive and dataset Data Access Committees
solutions.access: DAC permission and approved research conditions
solutions.boundary: Research contribution never substitutes for access authorization or permits redistribution

proposed_participation_model.reward_trigger: Independently accepted, licensed, unique task artifact; idempotent credit event
proposed_participation_model.hours_policy: Declared hours recorded separately and not sufficient for award
proposed_participation_model.outreach_policy: Prepare concrete offer; deliver only through an allowed opt-in endpoint with identified operator policy; no mass unsolicited sending
proposed_participation_model.scientific_scope: Computational evidence and reproducibility research; no organism intervention instructions
proposed_participation_model.market_viability: Unproven until a real authorized operator accepts and produces a reproducible contribution

prototype_acceptance: Source layers and entity kinds explicit
Missing transport or credential is an explicit status, not false success
Findings preserve source, retrieval date, access terms and verification state
No execution of untrusted catalog instructions
Bounded requests and network destination validation
No acceptance inferred from silence or discovery
Idempotent rewards and duplicate contribution checks
Live discovery counts separate from real participants and accepted scientific results
